newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch CSS to be priced between NLG 15 and 17.
newsitem.headline: Dutch CSS to be priced between NLG 15 and 17.

text.p: The shares of Dutch firm Computer Services Solutions Holding NV (CSS) will be priced in a range between 15 and 17 guilders, CSS and Rabo Securities NV said on Monday in a joint statement.

Private and institutional investors can subscribe for the shares from April 22 to 25 and the equities will be marketed through a book-building procedure. Lead manager Rabo Securities has the right to close the subscription at an earlier date.
The CSS management will offer a maximum of 1.45 million of their shares in the company and CSS will issue a maximum of 50,000 new shares for the flotation.
Rabo Securities has a "green shoe" option to take up an aditional 225,000 existing CSS shares to cover over-allotments.
After introduction of the company in the New Market sector of the Amsterdam Stock Exchange (NMAX), the CSS management will still own a majority stake in the firm.
CSS previously said it wanted a bourse listing to finance future growth, which it expected to realise through organic expansion and takeovers.
The IT services provider posted 1996 net profit of 2.6 million guilders on turnover of 19.7 million.
In the first quarter of 1997, net profit grew by 52 percent to 0.9 million guilders and CSS said it expected full year profit developments to be in line with the first quarter trend.
